notes: Intro summary: Riverbend builds a B2B product analytics workspace with an embedded in-app assistant and advanced doc search. They're migrating from a single LLM API vendor to reduce cost and improve SLAs.
Current stack: calls out to 'OtherProvider' (OpenAI API) for chat + embeddings. Heavy embedding usage for semantic search (daily ingest ~5k docs).
Primary goals: match prompt output (parity), reduce 95th-percentile latency for long conversations, and get predictable unit economics for scale.
POC scope: replicate 12 core prompts (search reranking, concise summarization, follow-up Q/A) + run embeddings on 50k helpdesk docs. Two-week window; production-like traffic replay.

Observed issues so far: token accounting mismatch in Redwood hosted 'compat' layer vs incumbent causing cost delta; small style/regression in bullet summaries (~8% significant diff flagged by their eval harness).
Quote from product lead: 'We need answers to: can you hit our p95 SLA on 800–1k token conversations and give us a migration path that doesn't break UX?'

Security: needs SSO/SAML integration, organization-level audit logs retained for 12 months, and Azure region residency for EU customers. Legal will require SOC2 + data residency attestation before Dedicated purchase.

Commercial: interested in shifting to Redwood Hosted for quick win, then move to Dedicated reserved capacity in 6–9 months. Wants a blended price comparison vs current vendor (per-token + embedding units).
SE notes: try quantized model variant in Dedicated for cost tests; enable prefix caching for support conversation flows; run A/B on fallback routing to older OpenAI model to detect regressions.
Suggested artifacts: prompt parity test report CSV, POC perf dashboard (links in drive), sample transcript excerpts showing divergence, and preliminary Dedicated sizing deck.
deployment_constraints: Must support EU data residency (Azure), allow VPC peering for Dedicated, and provide an SSO/SAML SSO integration for engineers and PMs.
